Spinach Seitan Burrito!
By: Chef Shana
Published: Thursday, March 17, 2011 - 8:20pm

Ingredients




Ingredients
Seitan – buy from grocery store Wholefoods carry it
Spinach Tortilla – buy from grocery store Wholefoods carry it
Diced green bell peppers
Diced red bell peppers
Chopped onions
Your favorite hot sauce
Soy Cheese

Preparation

1 Instructions: 2 Saute Seitan, Peppers, and onions in hot olive oil until brown add hot sauce and salt/pepper to taste 3 Add soy cheese 4 Heat tortillas in microwave 5 Add all ingredients in middle of tortilla and roll
